_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Kai ne ɗan wasa {player_id} a wasan LinesOfAction.
Ƙafarka '{side}', ƙafar abokin hamayya '{other}'.
Tsarin motsa: `[b1b3]` (daga-tsarin zuwa-tsarin). Motsa ya doka tana tafiya a tsaye, a kwance, ko a diagonal, adadin murabba'i sawa da jimlar ƙafar (kowane launi) a cikin layin. Ka iya tsallaka ƙafarka, amma ba ƙafar abokin hamayya; sauka a kan abokin hamayya yana kamawa.  Ci nasara lokacin da duk ƙafarka suka haɗu a cikin maƙwabta 8.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsarin dole ne e2e4 (daga,zuwa haɗin kai).
invalid_move.identical: Tushen da makoma iri daya ne.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Dole ne motsi ya kasance madaidaiciya ko diagonal.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Dole ne ya motsa nisa daidai da guda a jere.
invalid_move.destination_own: Wurin da aka kama da wani abu.

game_action.captured_suffix: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya motsa {from} -> {to} kama abokin gaba.

outcome.draw_no_capture: An yi tafiyar 60 ba tare da an kama ba.
